data.name: ApePoint Extraction
data.detailed_description: ApePoint Extraction is a hardcore VR extraction shooter designed for players who want real tension, real risk, and real movement. Drop into hostile raids where every second matters. Search abandoned locations, uncover valuable loot, and survive against AI threats and real players who are after the same objective: get in, take what you can, and get out alive. This isn’t slow or scripted movement you physically move, climb, and fight your way through each raid. Every encounter is unpredictable. Every fight can cost you everything.

data.short_description: ApePoint Extraction is a hardcore VR extraction shooter built around real movement and high-stakes survival. Enter dangerous raids, scavenge for loot, fight other players, and escape before losing everything. Every decision matters. Every raid is a risk.
